seo.description: Daily brunch at Miss B's Coconut Club in Mission Beach, San Diego. Breakfast burritos, French toast, mimosas and morning cocktails served until 2pm on Mission Blvd.

hero.subheading: Brunch is served every day at Miss B's Coconut Club — from 9am on Saturday and Sunday, 10am Monday through Friday, until 2pm at 3704 Mission Blvd.

experience.imageAlt: Miss B's Coconut Club brunch interior Mission Beach San Diego
experience.heading:
Daily Brunch
on Mission Blvd
body: Miss B's Coconut Club serves brunch seven days a week in Mission Beach, with the full kitchen, open-air bar and outdoor patio available during service.

Order breakfast burritos, French toast, biscuits and gravy, açaí bowls, mimosas and morning cocktails steps from the Pacific. Walk-ins are welcome and reservations are recommended for busy weekend mornings.
